summary: Remove redundant controller installation from routine upgrade instructions
details: Installer completion guidance uses activate-release, doctor, up and status after the node is stopped. It explains that up reconciles recognized managed background services while preserving controller options and existing autostart settings.

Controller installation is documented as conditional for nodes that never installed it; custom systemd configuration still requires review. The handbook explains the outdated unconditional step in older installers. Installation and service-management behavior are unchanged.
